datasets.title: Niger Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Niger Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/niger_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2020 across Niger administrative units. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases derived from field assessments and integrated analysis, georeferenced to administrative boundaries and distributed in GeoJSON and KML formats.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
